configuration.status: descriptive extension; not an independent regime or forecasting test
configuration.universe: frozen original 200 stocks plus SPY; no holdings refresh
configuration.eligibility: 272 consecutive observed returns through old cutoff; freeze those names for both snapshots; assert subsequent completeness, never fill
configuration.snapshots: descriptive after-close fits, include cutoff close; no forward-return interpretation of in-sample coherence
configuration.geometry: separately fit intercept and SPY, standardize residual histories; stock vector z_i/sqrt(L-1); Euclidean distance sqrt(2*(1-rho))
configuration.centroid: Euclidean mean of fixed stock vectors, size-weighted after merging; no centroid renormalization; cut by merge count because heights can invert
configuration.comparisons: snapshot correlation/PC shares, K11 group balance, old-to-new ARI; no winning window or method selection
configuration.short_extension: post-cutoff cumulative returns and future residual-correlation gap with old-cutoff labels and frozen old 252-session SPY coefficients; descriptive only, shorter than original 20-session target
configuration.uncertainty: no confidence interval or significance test on this short extension; dates share most training data
configuration.economic_context: verify dates from primary releases; no causal assignment of price moves to an event
configuration.strategy: none; prior gross trading ledgers remain on their original data and dates
